info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 此課程主要介紹與探討Internet規約、運作機制與最新技術，藉由研究Internet中重要應用層通訊協定，多媒體網路協定、多媒體串流、即時語音通訊、差別化服務，以及資源保留的原理與訊息傳遞流程，以使學生建立Internet領域知識。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces and investigates Internet protocols, operations, and latest technologies. Through studying the principles and message flows of well-known application protocols, multimedia networking protocols, real-time streaming, Voice over IP, differentiated services, and resource reservation, students could have the domain knowledge of Internet.

targets.describe_en: Investigate and analyze design factors and solutions for network performance of Internet
